adversary_breaks.expected: Remaining allocation is stated regardless of a lapsed Pro row: '2 of 2 unspent' with the held-free-tickets allocation-retention note; the wallet is not labelled a Pro pass when the Pro entitlement has lapsed.
adversary_breaks.observed: With a lapsed verified_store grant (issued 14d before, expired 7d before the free allocation) plus the free allocation, both expired under anchored trusted time (ledger: spendableTickets=2, both verdicts 'expired'), Settings renders: 'EXPIRED | Offline pass expired | Allocation: Pro pass | Pass ends: Expired | Waiting to sync: Nothing | The pass end is measured by time confirmed with the server…'. The identical wallet without the lapsed Pro row renders '2 of 2 unspent' + 'stay allocated to this phone … never taken back automatically'. summarizeLease() prefers pro in the expired branch (`expired === null || (pro && !expired.pro)`) and the presenter then treats the whole wallet as a Pro lease (proLease => allocation row 'Pro pass', allocationNote null), so the free-ticket count and retention copy disappear.
adversary_breaks.title: Lapsed Pro lease hides the expired free allocation: card says 'Pro pass / Expired' and omits the 2 allocated free tickets and the allocation-retention statement

adversary_breaks.expected: The card states the held free allocation ('2 of 2 unspent') and that it stays allocated until sync, in addition to the unconfirmed-time explanation; a Pro lease that cannot be confirmed does not erase the free allocation facts.
adversary_breaks.observed: Free allocation (2 tickets) + a verified_store lease issued one day later; trusted time reading authority 'none' (ledger: spendableTickets=2, both verdicts reconcile_required/no_trusted_time). Settings renders 'CONFIRM ONLINE | Offline pass needs an online check | Allocation: Pro pass | Pass ends: Unconfirmed | Waiting to sync: Nothing | This phone has not confirmed the time…'. The 2 allocated free tickets and the 'stay allocated' statement are absent because the first grant in generation/issued_at DESC order is the Pro lease and summarizeLease() keeps the first reconcile entry, making proLease=true for the whole wallet.

  cmd: cd apps/mobile && npx jest --ci --silent __tests__/w05OfflineJourneyAttack.test.tsx -> exit 0, Test Suites 1/1, Tests 42 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped (attack-final.log).

 2 Crash/commit boundaries (2): SQLite commit acknowledgement lost after durable write -> next read shows the truth, no double-spend; commit failure before durability -> ticket remains unspent, no journal ghost.
 3 Replay/duplicate identities (4): duplicate verdict for the same receipt in one 200 body; foreign receipt id in the verdict list; extra foreign verdicts beside the real one; per-receipt refused outcome — every receipt accounted exactly once, no fabricated settlement.

The r4 commits (ecd07454 test, a448d54b impl) were cherry-picked unchanged, then two round-5 commits added: 1acebe5d (tests first, proven failing 8/8 pre-fix) and 45e8ad41 (fix). Defects found in the r4 candidate, apps/mobile/src/components/OfflineAllocationCard.tsx: (P1 A1/A2) summarizeLease() carried a `pro` flag on its expired/reconcile_required summaries, preferring the Pro row (`expired === null || (pro && !expired.pro)`, and first-reconcile-wins with the Pro lease listed first by generation/issued_at), and the presenter derived `proLease = lease.kind !== 'none' && lease.pro` — so a lapsed or unconfirmed Pro row beside 2 free tickets rendered 'Allocation: Pro pass' and dropped both the count and the ALLOCATION_STAYS retention note. (P3 A4) `unidentifiedHold = wallet.hold && onHold === 0` emitted UNIDENTIFIED_HOLD_RULE claiming the named receipt 'was never recorded on this phone' even when the receipt is on file and settled (wallet.pending excludes settled receipts). (P3 A6) the lease.kind==='none' HOLD note was hard-coded singular. Fix (all inside write_paths): LeaseSummary's expired/reconcile_required variants no longer carry `pro`; only a LIVE grant lends its entitlement. Presenter: `proLease = lease.kind==='active' ? lease.pro : lease.kind!=='none' && total===0 && grants.some(isProGrant)` — Pro-only wallets (no ticket ever allocated) still read 'Pro pass' under every verdict (r4 tests unchanged and passing), while a not-live Pro row beside allocated tickets leaves '2 of 2 unspent' + retention note exactly as without it. A live Pro pass beside held free tickets adds a 'Free analyses: N of M unspent' row (no retention note, per adversary A3). UNIDENTIFIED_HOLD_RULE now reads 'A result submission is on record, but it names no receipt that is still waiting on this phone, so its outcome cannot be read here. The next online sync closes it; nothing is charged twice.' With no grant rows the spent-analysis sentence agrees in number with wallet.pending.length (singular / plural) and is omitted when the HOLD names no pending receipt. Copy checked against docs/APP_STORE_SUBMISSION.md forbidden terms by expectDossierCompliant in every new test. Acceptance: AC1 136/136 (6 suites) exit 0; AC2 tsc exit 0; AC3 eslint+prettier exit 0; root pnpm format:check exit 0; git diff --check exit 0. Adversary suite (27 tests, not committed) also passes 27/27 against HEAD. No PR opened; no push to main or ci/mac-*; no production/native/backend/data-layer files touched.

Defects found in the r4 candidate, apps/mobile/src/components/OfflineAllocationCard.tsx: (P1 A1/A2) summarizeLease() carried a `pro` flag on its expired/reconcile_required summaries, preferring the Pro row (`expired === null || (pro && !expired.pro)`, and first-reconcile-wins with the Pro lease listed first by generation/issued_at), and the presenter derived `proLease = lease.kind !== 'none' && lease.pro` — so a lapsed or unconfirmed Pro row beside 2 free tickets rendered 'Allocation: Pro pass' and dropped both the count and the ALLOCATION_STAYS retention note. (P3 A4) `unidentifiedHold = wallet.hold && onHold === 0` emitted UNIDENTIFIED_HOLD_RULE claiming the named receipt 'was never recorded on this phone' even when the receipt is on file and settled (wallet.pending excludes settled receipts). (P3 A6) the lease.kind==='none' HOLD note was hard-coded singular. Fix (all inside write_paths): LeaseSummary's expired/reconcile_required variants no longer carry `pro`; only a LIVE grant lends its entitlement. Presenter: `proLease = lease.kind==='active' ? lease.pro : lease.kind!=='none' && total===0 && grants.some(isProGrant)` — Pro-only wallets (no ticket ever allocated) still read 'Pro pass' under every verdict (r4 tests unchanged and passing), while a not-live Pro row beside allocated tickets leaves '2 of 2 unspent' + retention note exactly as without it. A live Pro pass beside held free tickets adds a 'Free analyses: N of M unspent' row (no retention note, per adversary A3). UNIDENTIFIED_HOLD_RULE now reads 'A result submission is on record, but it names no receipt that is still waiting on this phone, so its outcome cannot be read here. The next online sync closes it; nothing is charged twice.' With no grant rows the spent-analysis sentence agrees in number with wallet.pending.length (singular / plural) and is omitted when the HOLD names no pending receipt. Copy checked against docs/APP_STORE_SUBMISSION.md forbidden terms by expectDossierCompliant in every new test. implement.summary: Defect on BASE_SHA 7cfeacbb: there is no offline journey surface at all — apps/mobile/src/components/OfflineAllocationCard.tsx does not exist and neither apps/mobile/src/screens/AnalyzeScreen.tsx nor apps/mobile/src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx reads readOfflineAllocation()/readOfflineWalletStatus(), so remaining allocation, lease expiry, pending receipts and HOLD are never shown (the regression suite cannot even load on base). Defects on the r4 candidate fda1aeff that this lane resolves (file:line in the r4 card): summarizeLease() line 190 `expired === null || (pro && !expired.pro)` let a lapsed Pro row name the whole wallet's expiry, and lines 187-189 kept the first reconcile entry (the later-issued Pro lease, listed first by issued_at DESC); the presenter then derived `proLease = lease.kind !== 'none' && lease.pro` (line 254) and used it for the Allocation row (line 288 'Pro pass') and to null the allocation note (line 339), erasing '2 of 2 unspent' and the retention statement (P1 A1, A2). UNIDENTIFIED_HOLD_RULE (lines 107-110) asserted the receipt 'was never recorded on this phone' even when it is on file and settled (P3 A4). The no-grant HOLD note (line 321) was singular for any count (P3 A6). Fix (all inside write_paths): LeaseSummary now carries an entitlement only on a LIVE lease (`expired` / `reconcile_required` variants have no `pro`); the presenter computes `proLive = lease.kind==='active' && lease.pro` and states the Allocation row from the ticket ledger whenever `held+spent > 0` ('N of M unspent'), falling back to 'Pro pass' only when the wallet holds a Pro grant and no tickets; the retention note is shown whenever tickets are held and no Pro lease is live (so EXPIRED / CONFIRM ONLINE keep '2 of 2 unspent' + 'stay allocated…never taken back' and the trusted-time explanation stays); unidentified-HOLD copy now reads 'it names no receipt still waiting on this phone'; the no-grant HOLD note pluralises by the on-hold count. Card is wired into the shipping paths: AnalyzeScreen ready surface via useOfflineJourneyOnFocus(navigation) (mount/focus/foreground/owner reads, dark card) and SettingsScreen via useOfflineJourney() for synced accounts. Commits: 7ac5c98b (regression test only) then 71967640 (implementation). Copy checked against docs/APP_STORE_SUBMISSION.md vocabulary via the FORBIDDEN_COPY sweep in the suite. No PR opened; pushed to devin/pp/w05-04/impl-r5-c2 only.
